bofa.label: BofA Bull & Bear
bofa.description: BofA Bull & Bear at 9.7 (Aug 7 FMS); formal sell signal triggered — first since 2021; highest reading in 5 years; Hartnett urges Retreat/Rotate from tech/semis into staples/REITs/small-caps

fearGreed.label: CNN Fear & Greed
fearGreed.description: Shifted to greed at 61.6 (CNN, Aug 11); massive reversal from 38.5 fear in late July; prior close 64.4; market sentiment recovered sharply after July dip

vix.label: VIX Index
vix.description: VIX at 15.28 (CBOE, Aug 11); 17.8% below long-term avg of 18.59; volatility compressed as market recovered from July selloff

aaii.label: AAII Bull-Bear Spread
aaii.description: AAII spread narrowed to -0.9% (Aug 6); bulls at 37%, bears at 38%; sentiment recovered sharply from -12.7% in late July after Fed pause

cta.label: CTA Exposure Percentile
cta.description: CTA positioning dropped to ~44th percentile (GS, Aug); major deleveraging from 75th in July; systematic funds hold $196B long US equities; selling pressure eased

cash.label: Fund Manager Cash
cash.description: BofA FMS: cash at 3.6% (July survey); below 4% sell threshold; August FMS confirms sell signal with Bull & Bear at 9.7; Hartnett recommends reallocating to cash

levEtfAum.label: Leveraged ETF AUM
levEtfAum.description: Leveraged ETF AUM remains elevated at ~$110B; no significant change; positioning risk persists

streetGamma.label: Street Gamma Position
streetGamma.description: SPX dealer gamma at +$3B per 1% move (Aug 4, optioncharts.io); flipped positive after Fed; pre-Fed negative gamma amplified July selloff; SPY GEX +$12.3B (Aug 7); positive = stabilizing

sox.label: SOX Drawdown
sox.description: SOX drawdown at ~17% (Aug 12); index at 12,096; narrowed from 20% as semis recovered; SOXX down 15.8% from July peak; still in bear market territory

ndx.label: NDX Performance
ndx.description: NDX at 29,499 (Aug 11); ~4% below all-time high of 30,740 (Jun 2); recovered from -11% dip in late July; MAG7 resilience continues

russell2000.label: Russell 2000 YTD
russell2000.description: RUT at 3,017 (Aug 10); YTD +22.4% (VTWO); small caps significantly outperforming large-cap tech; rotation into small-caps accelerating per BofA recommendation
